notes: Why these bands: the toolkit defines three proficiency levels — Competent, Proficient, Expert — "based on training, experience and performance", and tags training to staff levels entry / mid / senior (Ch. 7). It sets no year thresholds, so the survey bands are mapped to those three stages: up to 5 years = entry (Competent), 6–10 = mid-career (Proficient), more than 10 = senior (Expert).
Depth keeps a step between <2 and 2–5 years so the earlier rule (juniors under 2 years rank lowest) still holds inside Competent.
This replaces the earlier 5-level composite (Aware → Strategic). Seniority and external consultation now count only in Impact, not in the level.

Source: the internal staff survey question on years of professional experience. Haya Sulaiman Alothaimeen and Abdullah Alqahtani are not in the survey — their years are carried from the Phase-2 workbook.
